body:
WHAT
While OVERDRIVE is on, the system prompt carries an extra section titled `# OVERDRIVE — fully-autonomous mode` that tells the model the user is not watching, that nothing asks (deletions, .magentra and .env edits, writes outside the workspace all run), and that only a user-written deny rule can stop a call. The section is added when OVERDRIVE is switched on and removed when it is switched off, so it is present exactly while ON.

WHY
The permission engine stops asking in OVERDRIVE; if the prompt still told the model to expect confirmations it would pause to ask questions nobody will answer, or act carelessly without knowing no net exists.

WHERE
engine/core/src/agent/prompts.ts — SECTION_HARNESS (the standing line 'if an OVERDRIVE section appears, not even on those'), buildSystemPrompt() `extraSections`. The section itself: engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — OVERDRIVE_PROMPT_SECTION (id system.overdrive), Session.setOverdrive() → setPromptSection('overdrive', …), Session.buildSystemPrompt() spreading dynamicSections.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. With OVERDRIVE off, the FakeProvider request's system prompt does not contain '# OVERDRIVE — fully-autonomous mode' but does contain the SECTION_HARNESS sentence about 'if an OVERDRIVE section appears'.
2. After setOverdrive(true), the next request's system prompt contains '# OVERDRIVE — fully-autonomous mode' and 'NOTHING asks' exactly once.
3. After setOverdrive(false) again, the following request's system prompt no longer contains the OVERDRIVE section.
4. setOverdrive(true) emits overdrive_changed {enabled:true} and calling it twice with the same value emits nothing the second time.
5. buildSystemPrompt({env, extraSections:['X']}) places 'X' after the environment block, matching where the OVERDRIVE section lands.
